title: 19.6 A 60GHz I/Q-Calibrated SSB-Mixer-Based LO with Sub-ns Settling Time and -56dBc Worst-Case Spur Using ILO Filter in 28nm CMOS
problem: Joint Communication-and-Sensing (JCAS) systems using SC-OFDM (stepped-carrier OFDM) require local oscillators (LOs) with fast frequency-hopping settling (<18ns for IEEE 802.11ay) and low spurious tones; traditional LOs cannot meet both stringent jitter and settling requirements simultaneously.
motivation: JCAS in mmWave bands (60GHz) with SC-OFDM enables high data rates and radar resolution; LO settling time must be shorter than guard intervals, placing extreme demands on frequency-hopping speed.
method: The circuit uses a 60GHz local oscillator based on single-sideband mixer technology (using only half the frequency spectrum) combined with an integrated LC filter (made of inductors and capacitors). It achieves sub-nanosecond frequency switching (less than a billionth of a second) through a rapid frequency-hopping architecture that quickly jumps between frequencies. I/Q calibration—a technique that balances the two perpendicular components of the radio signal—suppresses spurious tones to -56dBc (56 decibels below the main signal).
key_novelty: This design combines single-sideband mixer technology, integrated LC filtering, and I/Q calibration to create a 60GHz oscillator that achieves both sub-nanosecond frequency switching and -56dBc spurious suppression—two performance goals that traditional radio oscillators struggle to meet together.
contributions: Sub-nanosecond settling time LO for fast SC-OFDM frequency hopping
SSB mixer-based architecture with I/Q calibration for spur suppression
Integrated LC oscillator (ILO) filter achieving -56dBc worst-case spur level

metrics.other: Sub-nanosecond settling time, -56 dBc worst-case spur, 60GHz operation

baselines: Prior LO designs lacking fast settling, prior fast-settling designs with high spurs
limitations: Jitter performance, power consumption, and detailed comparison with other mmWave LO solutions not provided; SC-OFDM system-level performance not demonstrated.
primary_theme: Fast-settling low-spur mmWave LO for JCAS
